evals.name: proposal-plus-impl
evals.prompt: I just finished proposing and implementing the motion profile generator. Can you commit everything?
evals.expected_output: Two commits: a `proposal:` commit containing only openspec/changes/motion-profile-generator/* and a `feat:` commit containing the .cpp + .hpp + test together. Both commits carry Co-Authored-By and Signed-off-by trailers.

assertions.name: exactly_2_new_commits
assertions.description: Created exactly 2 new commits beyond baseline.

assertions.name: proposal_commit_exists_and_is_isolated
assertions.description: Has a commit whose subject starts with 'proposal:' and which contains only paths under openspec/changes/motion-profile-generator/.

assertions.name: impl_commit_pairs_feature_with_tests
assertions.description: Has a non-proposal commit that contains both src/planner/profile.cpp AND tests/planner/test_profile.cpp (feature + its test in the same commit).

assertions.name: no_commit_mixes_openspec_and_code
assertions.description: No single commit contains both an openspec/changes/ path and a src/ or tests/ or include/ path.

assertions.name: all_new_commits_have_co_authored_by
assertions.description: Every new commit message contains a 'Co-Authored-By: Claude' trailer.

assertions.name: all_new_commits_have_signed_off_by
assertions.description: Every new commit message contains a 'Signed-off-by:' trailer.

assertions.name: subject_uses_conventional_type
assertions.description: Every new commit subject begins with one of: proposal:, archive:, feat, fix, chore, docs, test, refactor, perf, build, ci, style (with optional scope).

evals.name: two-unrelated-changes
evals.prompt: Stage and commit what I have, splitting into atomic commits.
evals.expected_output: Three commits: planner-limits change paired with its test, logger change alone, README typo alone. Each carries both trailers.

assertions.name: exactly_3_new_commits
assertions.description: Created exactly 3 new commits beyond baseline.

assertions.name: planner_commit_pairs_feature_with_tests
assertions.description: One commit contains both src/planner/limits.cpp AND tests/planner/test_limits.cpp.

assertions.name: logger_commit_isolated
assertions.description: One commit contains src/logging/logger.cpp and does NOT also contain planner or README files.

assertions.name: readme_commit_isolated
assertions.description: One commit contains README.md and does NOT also contain planner or logger files.

assertions.name: readme_uses_docs_type
assertions.description: The commit touching README.md uses subject type 'docs' (e.g. 'docs:' or 'docs(...):').

assertions.name: no_commit_mixes_subsystems
assertions.description: No single commit mixes planner, logging, and docs paths.

assertions.name: all_new_commits_have_co_authored_by
assertions.description: Every new commit has a Co-Authored-By: Claude trailer.

assertions.name: all_new_commits_have_signed_off_by
assertions.description: Every new commit has a Signed-off-by: trailer.

evals.name: archive-plus-cleanup
evals.prompt: I'm done with the pre-commit-ci change. Commit my work.
evals.expected_output: Two commits: an `archive:` commit for the openspec rename, and a separate cleanup commit for src/util/string_utils.cpp. notes.txt is held back, not auto-committed.

assertions.name: exactly_2_new_commits
assertions.description: Created exactly 2 new commits beyond baseline.

assertions.name: archive_commit_exists_and_is_isolated
assertions.description: Has a commit whose subject starts with 'archive:' that contains only paths under openspec/changes/ (the rename move).

assertions.name: cleanup_commit_isolated
assertions.description: Has a non-archive commit that contains src/util/string_utils.cpp and does NOT contain any openspec/changes/ paths.

assertions.name: no_commit_mixes_openspec_and_code
assertions.description: No single commit contains both an openspec/changes/ path and a src/ or include/ path.

assertions.name: notes_txt_not_committed
assertions.description: notes.txt is NOT in any new commit (still untracked or explicitly held back).

assertions.name: all_new_commits_have_co_authored_by
assertions.description: Every new commit has a Co-Authored-By: Claude trailer.

assertions.name: all_new_commits_have_signed_off_by
assertions.description: Every new commit has a Signed-off-by: trailer.
